autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 浮层被遮挡时是否自动调整方向。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether to flip the popup automatically when it is clipped.

class.en-US: Class name of the root element.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除图标，showClear 为 true 时有效。
clearIcon.en-US: Custom clear icon; effective when showClear is true.

defaultOpen.zh-CN: 非受控时面板是否默认打开。
defaultOpen.en-US: Whether the panel is open by default when uncontrolled.

defaultValue.zh-CN: 非受控时的初始时间，形态同 value；type 为 timeRange 时为数组。
defaultValue.en-US: Initial time when uncontrolled, in the same forms as value; an array when type is timeRange.

disabledHours.en-US: Returns the hours that cannot be selected.

disabledMinutes.zh-CN: 按所选小时返回禁止选择的分钟。
disabledMinutes.en-US: Returns the minutes that cannot be selected for the selected hour.

disabledSeconds.zh-CN: 按所选小时和分钟返回禁止选择的秒。
disabledSeconds.en-US: Returns the seconds that cannot be selected for the selected hour and minute.

disabledTime.zh-CN: 仅范围模式生效：按当前值与面板位置返回左右面板各自的禁用规则。value 中未选的一侧为 undefined；返回值中的 disabledHours、disabledMinutes、disabledSeconds 覆盖顶层的同名属性，未返回的回退到顶层。单选模式下忽略。
disabledTime.en-US: Range mode only: returns the disabled rules of the left and right panel from the current value and the panel. The unpicked side of value is undefined; a returned disabledHours, disabledMinutes or disabledSeconds overrides the prop of the same name, and one left out falls back to it. Ignored in single mode.

focusOnOpen.zh-CN: 挂载后让输入框获得焦点并选中内容，同时打开面板。
focusOnOpen.en-US: Focuses the input and selects its content once mounted, which opens the panel.

format.zh-CN: 展示的时间格式，遵循 date-fns 的 format；use12Hours 为 true 时默认为 a h:mm:ss，否则为 HH:mm:ss。
format.en-US: Display format, following date-fns format. Defaults to a h:mm:ss with use12Hours, else HH:mm:ss.

hideDisabledOptions.en-US: Hides the options that cannot be selected.

hourStep.zh-CN: 小时选项的间隔，必须是正整数。
hourStep.en-US: Interval of the hour options; a positive integer.

inputReadOnly.zh-CN: 输入框只读，避免在移动设备上打开虚拟键盘；只读时清除按钮仍可用。
inputReadOnly.en-US: Makes the input read-only, which avoids opening the virtual keyboard on mobile devices; the clear button stays usable.

inputStyle.zh-CN: 输入框根元素的样式，接受对象（键用 kebab-case）或字符串。
inputStyle.en-US: Style of the input's root element; an object (kebab-case keys) or a string.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 输入框内部的前缀标签，显示在输入框内。
insetLabel.en-US: Prefix label shown inside the input.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: insetLabel 的 id，用于 aria-labelledby 等关联。
insetLabelId.en-US: id of the insetLabel, referenced through aria-labelledby and similar attributes.

maxLength.zh-CN: 输入框的最大字符数，透传给输入框。
maxLength.en-US: Maximum number of characters of the input, passed through to the input.

minLength.zh-CN: 输入框的最小字符数，透传给输入框。
minLength.en-US: Minimum number of characters of the input, passed through to the input.

minuteStep.zh-CN: 分钟选项的间隔，必须是正整数。
minuteStep.en-US: Interval of the minute options; a positive integer.

open.zh-CN: 面板是否打开，受控属性；undefined 视为非受控。
open.en-US: Whether the panel is open; a controlled property, and undefined means uncontrolled.

panelFooter.zh-CN: 面板底部的内容。范围模式下可传数组，第 i 项用于第 i 个面板。
panelFooter.en-US: Content below the panel. In range mode an array, whose item i is used for panel i.

panelHeader.zh-CN: 面板头部的内容。范围模式下可传数组，第 i 项用于第 i 个面板。
panelHeader.en-US: Content above the panel. In range mode an array, whose item i is used for panel i.

panels.zh-CN: 仅范围模式：第 i 项同时作为第 i 个面板的头部和底部，优先于 panelHeader 与 panelFooter。单选模式下忽略。
panels.en-US: Range mode only: item i is used as both the header and the footer of panel i, taking precedence over panelHeader and panelFooter. Ignored in single mode.

placeholder.zh-CN: 没有值时显示的提示，默认取语言包中对应 type 的文案。
placeholder.en-US: Hint shown without a value; defaults to the locale text of type.

popupStyle.zh-CN: 弹出层的样式，接受对象（键用 kebab-case）或字符串。
popupStyle.en-US: Style of the popup; an object (kebab-case keys) or a string.

position.zh-CN: 浮层位置，type 为 timeRange 时默认为 bottom，为 time 时默认为 bottomLeft；RTL 方向下默认为 bottomRight。
position.en-US: Popup position. Defaults to bottom when type is timeRange, and bottomLeft when it is time; bottomRight under RTL.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 指示浏览器是否应滚动文档以显示新聚焦的元素，作用于组件内的 focus 调用。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the browser should scroll the document to show the newly focused element; applies to the focus call inside the component.

rangeSeparator.en-US: Separator between the two times of a range.

scrollItemProps.zh-CN: 传给各列的属性，只支持 cycled、mode、motion、transform，含义同 ScrollList 的 ScrollItem。
scrollItemProps.en-US: Props passed to the columns; only cycled, mode, motion and transform, as on the ScrollItem of ScrollList.

secondStep.zh-CN: 秒选项的间隔，必须是正整数。
secondStep.en-US: Interval of the second options; a positive integer.

showClear.en-US: Whether to show the clear button.

size.zh-CN: 输入框的大小，可选 large、default 或 small。
size.en-US: Size of the input: large, default or small.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止弹出层上的点击事件冒泡。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether to stop click events on the popup from bubbling.

style.zh-CN: 根元素的样式，接受对象（键用 kebab-case）或字符串。
style.en-US: Style of the root element; an object (kebab-case keys) or a string.

timeZone.zh-CN: 时区：数字为相对 UTC 的小时偏移，字符串为 IANA 时区名；未设置时取 ConfigProvider 的 timeZone。
timeZone.en-US: Time zone: a number is the hour offset from UTC, a string is an IANA time zone name; defaults to the timeZone of ConfigProvider.

triggerRender.zh-CN: 自定义触发器的渲染函数，只调用一次，入参的字段都是活的，在返回的 JSX 中读取才会更新。入参含 disabled、placeholder、value（Date 数组，未选的一侧为 undefined）、inputValue、componentProps（TimePicker 的属性，不含 ref）和 onChange（更新输入框文本，效果同键入）。
triggerRender.en-US: Renders a custom trigger. It is called once, and its fields are live: read them in the returned JSX to update. The argument has disabled, placeholder, value (an array of Date, the unpicked side undefined), inputValue, componentProps (the props of the TimePicker, without ref) and onChange (updates the input text, as typing would).

type.zh-CN: 选择类型，time 为单个时间，timeRange 为时间范围。
type.en-US: Selection type: time for a single time, timeRange for a range.

use12Hours.zh-CN: 使用 12 小时制，为 true 时 format 默认为 a h:mm:ss。
use12Hours.en-US: Uses the 12-hour clock; when true, format defaults to a h:mm:ss.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，仅影响展示样式。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status, which only affects the display style.

value.zh-CN: 当前时间，type 为 timeRange 时为数组；传 null 是受控的空值，undefined 视为非受控。
value.en-US: Current time; an array when type is timeRange. null is a controlled empty value, and undefined means uncontrolled.

onBlur.zh-CN: 点击外部关闭面板时的回调，参数为该次 mousedown 的原生事件。
onBlur.en-US: Callback when a click outside closes the panel, with the native event of that mousedown.

onChange.zh-CN: 时间变化的回调。type 为 time 时参数为 (Date, 格式化字符串)，type 为 timeRange 时两者都是数组。
onChange.en-US: Callback when the time changes. With type time it gets (Date, formatted string); with timeRange both are arrays.

onFocus.zh-CN: 输入框获得焦点时的回调。
onFocus.en-US: Callback when the input gains focus.

onOpenChange.zh-CN: 面板打开或关闭时的回调，参数为是否打开。
onOpenChange.en-US: Callback when the panel opens or closes, with whether it is open.

ref.zh-CN: 根元素的引用；其 focus() 与 blur() 作用于输入框，使用自定义触发器时无效。
ref.en-US: Reference to the root element; its focus() and blur() act on the input, and do nothing with a custom trigger.
